# omadafusion_device (Resource)

Settings of an adopted device (gateway, switch or AP): name, LED and AP radios. The device must already be adopted. Only attributes you set are managed. Destroying the resource leaves the device as it is; it does not forget it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Name an adopted AP, turn its LED off and pin its 5 GHz channel.
resource "omadafusion_device" "lobby_ap" {
  mac  = "aa:bb:cc:00:00:02"
  name = "AP-Lobby"
  led  = "off"
  radio_5g = {
    channel        = "36"
    tx_power_level = 2
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) Device MAC address, any common format.

### Optional

- `led` (String) `on`, `off` or `site` (follow the site setting).
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `radio_2g` (Attributes) 2.4 GHz radio of an access point. Only attributes you set are managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--radio_2g))
- `radio_5g` (Attributes) 5 GHz radio of an access point. Only attributes you set are managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--radio_5g))
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version at the last refresh.
- `id` (String) Device MAC.
- `ip` (String) Management IP at the last refresh.
- `model` (String) Model.
- `type` (String) `gateway`, `switch` or `ap`.

<a id="nestedatt--radio_2g"></a>
### Nested Schema for `radio_2g`

Optional:

- `channel` (String) Channel number, or `0` for auto.
- `channel_width` (String) Channel width code as the controller stores it (for example `2` 20 MHz, `3` 40 MHz, `5` 80 MHz, `4`/`6` 20/40 or 20/40/80 auto).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Radio on or off.
- `tx_power_level` (Number) Transmit power level: 0 low, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 custom, 4 auto.


<a id="nestedatt--radio_5g"></a>
### Nested Schema for `radio_5g`

Optional:

- `channel` (String) Channel number, or `0` for auto.
- `channel_width` (String) Channel width code as the controller stores it (for example `2` 20 MHz, `3` 40 MHz, `5` 80 MHz, `4`/`6` 20/40 or 20/40/80 auto).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Radio on or off.
- `tx_power_level` (Number) Transmit power level: 0 low, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 custom, 4 auto.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <mac> or <site>/<mac>
terraform import omadafusion_device.lobby_ap aa:bb:cc:00:00:02
```
